title: BoJ sets to raise interest rates by 25 bps next week - Reuters
summary: According to a Reuters report, sources say that the Bank of Japan (BoJ) is set to raise interest rates, most likely by 25 basis points, at the policy meeting on September 18. This move will push interest rates higher to 1.25%, a level not seen in the last 31 years.

title: Gold Is Falling, but Silver Has the Bigger Problem as Oil Drives Yields Higher
summary: Gold and Silver are both falling as oil-driven yields lift Fed hike expectations, but Silver is losing twice—once through the same rate pressure hitting Gold, and again through its industrial-demand exposure—a divergence the Gold/Silver ratio has just confirmed with a decisive breakout. The post Gold Is Falling, but Silver Has the Bigger Problem as Oil Drives Yields Higher appeared first on ActionForex .

title: United States Dollar Index holds onto gains above 99 ahead of US CPI data
summary: The US Dollar (USD) clings to its Thursday gains in early session on Friday, driven by faster-than-expected growth in the United States (US) Producer Price Index (PPI) data for August.

title: Australian Dollar softens to near 0.7150, US CPI inflation data looms
summary: The AUD/USD pair edges lower to around 0.7155 during the early Asian session on Friday. The US Dollar strengthens against the Australian Dollar (AUD) following signs of hotter inflation in the United States (US).

title: Swiss Franc declines as US Dollar strengthens on rising Fed hike bets
summary: USD/CHF gains ground for the third consecutive day, trading around 0.8140 during the Asian hours on Friday. The pair appreciates as the US Dollar (USD) gains ground as expectations grow for a Federal Reserve (Fed) rate hike in September.

title: Gold eyes $4,300 break as USD sticks to gains amid Fed hike bets, ahead of US CPI
summary: Gold (XAU/USD) struggles to register any meaningful recovery and languishes near a one-and-a-half-week low, touched during the Asian session on Friday.

title: Republican midterm convention wraps up in Dallas, Texas: Key takeaways
summary: Protesters gather on final night as US Republicans seek to rally base ahead of consequential legislative elections.

title: EUR/JPY Price Forecast: Softens to near 179.00, bearish bias remains intact below 100-day SMA
summary: The EUR/JPY cross trades in negative territory around 179.10 during the early European session on Friday. The expectation of a Bank of Japan (BoJ) rate hike next week provides some support to the Japanese Yen (JPY) against the Euro (EUR).

title: Asian Stocks decline as surging oil prices stoke inflation fears and lift Fed hike bets
summary: Asian stocks declined sharply on Friday, tracking the overnight fall on Wall Street, as a surge in energy prices and a global bond selloff trigger the broader risk-off move.

title: Trump jokes Republicans can ‘cheat like hell’ in the midterms
summary: US President Donald Trump has jokingly asked Republican voters to ‘cheat like hell’ in the midterms, ‘like Democrats’.
